stories.title: U.N. nuclear chief says inspectors will visit Iran, but Iran says only after final deal
stories.description: The head of the U.N.'s atomic agency said Iran's nuclear enrichment sites would be inspected as part of the interim deal. Iran insists any such visit would only come after a final deal.

stories.title: U.S. lifts Iran oil sanctions. And, federal judge rules SAVE voter tool unlawful
stories.description: The U.S. has temporarily lifted oil sanctions on Iran as peace talks continue. And, a federal judge ruled that the Trump administration's data system, known as SAVE, is unlawful.

stories.title: Who would pay for Trump's proposed $300 billion Iran reconstruction fund?
stories.description: It's still unclear who would fund a proposed $300 billion reconstruction plan for Iran. Former National Security Adviser Jake Sullivan called the whole approach "something entirely new."

stories.title: A U.S.-Iran dispute over nuclear inspections clouds work to finalize a war-ending deal
stories.description: As U.S.-Iran talks continued, a break in the shipping bottleneck through the Strait of Hormuz appeared to be in the works.

stories.title: Lebanese struggle to get by in an ancient city under Israeli evacuation order
stories.description: In one of the oldest cities in Lebanon, once besieged by Alexander the Great, ordinary people struggle to survive Israeli attacks.

stories.title: UN nuclear chief says inspectors will visit Iran sites as part of war deal
stories.description: Rafael Grossi says the IAEA is "working on modalities" but an Iranian minister says such access would only be part of a final deal with the US.

stories.title: UN says it will evacuate sailors stranded in Strait of Hormuz, as Rubio warns against tolls

stories.title: Dozens of ships head through Strait of Hormuz after US-Iran deal
stories.description: Traffic in the waterway has risen since the US and Iran signed a deal aimed at ending the war, including 42 ships on Saturday alone.

stories.title: Israeli troops kill two in south Lebanon after lull in fighting, authorities say
stories.description: Israel's military says the two men were Hezbollah operatives, but the Iran-backed group accuses it of a ceasefire violation.

stories.title: Iran says no new commitments on nuclear sites after Vance says inspectors to be invited back

stories.title: First round of US-Iran talks ends with encouraging progress, mediators say

stories.title: Israel and Hezbollah continue strikes despite ceasefire agreement

stories.title: Was JD Vance snubbed by Qatar's prime minister?
